headline: Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Step 5 Preview join AnyRouter, both with a 1M window
share: Claude Sonnet 5.5 and StepFun's Step 5 Preview are on AnyRouter. Both take 1M tokens of context: Sonnet 5.5 at $2/$10 per million, Step 5 Preview at $1.08/$3.09.
rationale: The baseline did not advance after 001 and 002, so 12 of the 14 'added' models in this record were already filmed. Only Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Step 5 Preview are new on 2026-09-29. Two cards, not a hero: both are genuinely new, and a hero on Sonnet alone would silently drop Step 5. Sonnet leads as the known lab's flagship.
